column1: # comment: Name alignments for comprehensive, multi-culture interop — schema.org, vCard 4 (N components, nickname, fn), GEDCOM X (gx:) name parts, FOAF, and a few well-established Wikidata properties. Multi-cultural name-part KINDS (gmeow:NamePartType value individuals such as namePartGiven/namePartSurname) align closeMatch to the nearest external concept, following the places.ttl idiom; there are no flat given/family name properties — a 'First Last' rendering is produced by downcasting the structured gmeow:NamePart model in the projection layer (projections/*). PronounSet, NameRegister, NameUsage and the inclusivity machinery (displayable, namePurposeChosen/Deadname) are largely CANONICAL — no maintained external RDF vocabulary covers them faithfully; co-equality of multilingual names is a structural stance, not an external mapping. Coreference of name INSTANCES is done in data, not here.
